name: Lips
source:
Have you ever wanted to kiss a shark? Well, now you can. Five kissable sharks are waiting for you to plant your lips on their noses in this visual novel.

[From [url=http://meltymole.itch.io/lips]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你有没有想过亲吻鲨鱼？好吧，现在你可以了。在这部视觉小说中，五只可亲吻的鲨鱼正在等待你将嘴唇放在它们的鼻子上。

[来自[url=http://meltymole.itch.io/lips]Itch.io[/url]]
